detail.longDescription: When using the Python API, I want to understand the data transfer behavior of loadTable vs to_pandas . The database table has millions of rows and I don't want to accidentally trigger a full transfer. import dolphindb as ddb s = ddb.session() s.connect("localhost", 8848, "admin", "123456") # Does this already pull data? t = s.loadTable("dfs://stock_db", "tick") # Or does the actual transfer happen here? df = t.to_pandas() What I'm really asking: does loadTable() return a lazy reference (metadata/handle only), or does it eagerly fetch some or all data? If I chain a filter before to_pandas() , is the filter pushed down to the server, or does it first transfer everything and then filter client-side? # Does this filter before transfer or after? df = s.loadTable("dfs://stock_db", "tick").select("sym", "price").where("date=2025.01.01").to_pandas()
